body.p: Appl. No. 17/435,850 July 15, 2024AMENDMENT TO THE CLAIMS:
The following claim set replaces all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1.-16. (canceled)215
17. (currently amended) A method of making a flexible electrode comprising the steps of:(a) electrospinning a nanofiber mat SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.161.63 comprised of a nonwoven mass of polymeric nanofibers;SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.1270.49SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.161.123SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.1271.22(b) depositing a conductive component on or within the nanofiber mat; and (c) photolithographically forming electrical traces on or within the nanofiber mat layer.
18. (currently amended) The method according to claim 17, which further comprises the step of :(d) coating the nanofiber mat substrate layer and electrical traces with a silicone layer; and thereafter (e) etching regions of the silicone layer to form contact points.
19. (original) The method according to claim 18, which further comprises the step of:(f) forming a final shape of the electrode.
20. (currently amended) The method according to claim 17, wherein step (b) comprises applying a photoresist material onto the nanofiber mat substratc and etching conductive channel patterns.SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.160.347
21. (original) The method according to claim 20, wherein step (b) comprises incorporating an electrically conductive material in the channel patterns.
22. (new) The method according to claim 17, wherein between steps (a) and (b) there is practiced a step of:(a1) depositing a photoresist onto the nanofiber mat and allowing the photoresist to fill a lower region of the nanofiber mat and thereby coat the polymeric nanofibers therein and establish a top surface region of the nanofiber mat comprised of polymeric nanofibers uncoated by the photoresist.
23. (new) The method according to claim 22, wherein step (b) comprises:(b1) depositing a conductive metal layer onto the top surface region of the nanofiber mat to provide a layer of conductive metal-coated polymeric nanofibers in at least a portion of the top surface region thereof.
24. (new) The method according to claim 23, wherein step (c) comprises:(c1) photolithographically forming electrical traces of the conductive metal- coated polymeric nanofibers in the top surface region of the nanofiber mat.
25. (new) The method according to claim 24, which further comprises the steps of:(d) applying silicone onto the nanofiber mat to form a silicone layer over the electrical traces; and thereafter (e) etching regions of the silicone layer to form contact points of the electrical traces.
26. (new) The method according to claim 25, which further comprises the step of:(f) forming a final shape of the electrode.
27. (new) The method according to claim 22, wherein step (a) comprises providing a silicon wafer, and electrospinning the nanofiber mat onto the silicon wafer.
28. (new) The method according to claim 24, which further comprises the step of:(d) applying silicone onto the nanofiber mat to form a silicon-filled nanofiber mat and a silicone layer over the electrical traces.
29. (new) The method according to claim 28, wherein the silicone layer has a thickness of about 5 pm.
30. (new) The method according to claim 28, which further comprises the step of:(f) etching regions of the silicone layer to form contact points of the electrical traces.
31. (new) The method according to claim 17, wherein the nanofiber mat fibrous substrate exhibits an elastic modulus of between about 50 MPa to about 5 GPa.
32. (new) The method according to claim 31, wherein the polymeric nanofibers comprise an insulating coating.
33. (new) The method according to claim 31, wherein the nanofiber mat substrate comprises a nanofiber layer which includes the polymeric nanofibers and an insulation layer.
34. (new) The method according to claim 33, wherein the insulation layer comprises a p-xylyene polymer or polydimethysiloxane.
35. (new) The method according to claim 17, wherein the polymeric nanofibers are formed of a plastic material selected from the group consisting of nylon,polycaprolactone, cellulose acetate, poly(methyl-methacrylate, ethylene vinyl alcohol and polyimide.
36. (new) The method according to claim 17, wherein the polymeric nanofibers are formed of nylon-6 and/or nylon-6,12.
